p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e8d8d89e.py'
content='''def transform(grid):
    # The colored object is a stencil; mark every matching all-background placement.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,1)]
    color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-max(a for a,b in shape)-0):
        for c in range(w-max(b for a,b in shape)-0):
            if all(grid[r+a][c+b] == 0 for a,b in shape):
                for a,b in shape: out[r+a][c+b]=color
    return out
'''
print(write_file(p,content))
